# `csharp_place_event_attribute_on_same_line`

Where an event's attribute section goes.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `false` |  |
| `if_owner_is_single_line` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_place_event_attribute_on_same_line = false`

```ini
max_line_length = 80
csharp_place_event_attribute_on_same_line = false
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    [NonSerialized]
    private int _cache;

    [field: NonSerialized]
    public event EventHandler? Changed;
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    [NonSerialized]
    private int _cache;

    [field: NonSerialized]
    public event EventHandler? Changed;
}
```
:::

::::
